name: Fat Mezz
description: Hard-driving, genre-bending rock four-piece from the Jersey Shore built on classic roots, with twin guitars and plenty of intensity.

name: Forever King Clark
description: Jersey Shore band playing alternative and psychedelic-tinged indie rock, a regular on Asbury Park bills and at Red Bank Porchfest.

name: GUTTER PEARL
description: Philadelphia band that bills its sound as a loud, sonic mix of psych and punk; regulars at West Philly Porchfest.

name: Granddogs
description: Philadelphia trio that calls its music 'three-voiced parlorcore', built on close three-part vocal harmony.

name: Hammered Hulls
description: Washington, D.C. punk band with Alec MacKaye on vocals and Mary Timony on bass, released on Dischord Records.

name: Human Wannabes
description: Philadelphia cover band playing songs from anime, video games and Vocaloid.

name: Island Time Lite
description: Lehigh Valley group playing laid-back summer songs by the likes of Jimmy Buffett, Paul Simon and Zac Brown, with acoustic instruments, congas and some comedy.

name: Lobster Tot Martini
description: High-energy southeastern Pennsylvania cover band playing classic rock and dance tunes.

name: Local Chapter
description: Central New Jersey act playing working-class Americana and road songs, booked regularly at Flounder Brewing.

name: Mamma Mania
description: New York City ABBA tribute that recreates the group's 70s pop and disco hits with live instruments and full vocal arrangements.

name: Modern Chemistry
description: New Jersey trio that formed around Rutgers, playing moody, atmospheric indie rock with post-punk and new wave shadows of Joy Division and Depeche Mode.

name: Moonroof
description: Bucks County and Philadelphia indie-pop band led by singer Dave Kim, formed at Bloomsburg University and signed to Free Dive Records.

name: Nicole Saphos Band
description: Philadelphia trio led by bassist and singer Nicole Saphos with Sean Markey on guitar and Ele Rubenstein on drums, playing alt-pop-leaning indie rock.

name: Oceanator
description: Indie rock project of Elise Okusami, from New York, with fuzzy guitars and heavy, hooky songs.

name: Oldest Sea
description: New Jersey project that has played ambient synth sets, slow and heavy, on Philadelphia and Lambertville bills.

name: Pale Shade
description: New Jersey band whose motto is 'pretty slow, really loud': heavy, drawn-out shoegaze and slowcore.

name: Postergirl
description: Philadelphia band playing MilkBoy, PhilaMOCA and West Philly Porchfest.

name: Pressing Strings
description: Annapolis, Maryland trio led by guitarist and singer Jordan Sokel, mixing blues, rock and folk; they tour widely and play festivals.

name: Riot Act
description: Pearl Jam tribute band that plays grunge tribute nights around Kennett Square, Bensalem and Philadelphia.

name: Rumbaile
description: New Jersey Latin band playing high-energy salsa, cumbia, bachata, boleros and Latin rock.

name: Ruth In The Bardo
description: Philadelphia project that tags its music 'southern baptist transcore', writing introspective songs about grief and change; toured in 2026.

name: Shut Up Gus
description: New Jersey four-piece of working musicians playing high-energy covers across many genres.

name: Stretch & the Armstrongs
description: Jersey Shore cover band that plays rock hits from the 1970s and 80s, regular at Bar Anticipation and Wonder Bar.

name: Tell Me Lies
description: Seven-piece Fleetwood Mac tribute playing the band's hits and Stevie Nicks solo songs live, with no backing tracks.

name: The Adventures of Matte Black
description: Duo of New Jersey native Madison Gerish and Maryland-based Daniel Skinner playing what they call factory western gothic Americana steampunk folk rock.

name: The Blackburns
description: Self-deprecating Delaware Valley rock band with pop-punk roots, releasing their album Alternative Rock on Sell the Heart Records.

name: The Brandywine Riders
description: Delaware-area jam band that posts live recordings and plays the Wilmington Brew Works beer garden.

name: The Coffin Ships
description: Band playing rowdy nights of Irish tunes at Flounder Brewing and Bucks County Brewery.

name: The Droogettes
description: All-female Philadelphia five-piece, active since 2013, playing what they call 'Sugar Oi!': street punk anthems with pop hooks.

name: The Lords of 52nd Street
description: Billy Joel's original 1970s band (Liberty DeVitto, Richie Cannata, Russell Javors) from Long Island, playing the songs they recorded with him; not a tribute act.

name: The No Good Crowd
description: Philadelphia roots-rock band formed in 2023 by guitarists Jamie Olson and Jim McGuinn, veterans of Cordalene and the Atlantic Coast Ramblers.

name: The Rock Orchestra
description: Delaware Valley group of local musicians that recreates classic rock records note for note, often full albums in sequence or career retrospectives of bands like Lynyrd Skynyrd, Genesis and Fleetwood Mac.

name: Thesaurus Rex
description: Brooklyn indie rock four-piece fronted by Calvin Rezen, coming out of New York City's local scene.

name: Toll Collectors
description: Christina Alessi and the Toll Collectors, a North Jersey five-piece playing Americana with country, rock and soul, plus fiddle, mandolin and stacked harmonies.

name: Warhawks
description: Gloucester City, NJ band led by brothers John and Pat Bilodeau, playing punchy garage punk and indie rock; their 2024 album Wellness Check topped the iTunes rock chart.

name: Wax Girl
description: Philadelphia band on West Philly Porchfest and Ruba Club, Ortlieb's and First Unitarian bills.

name: Wheatus
description: Long Island power-pop and pop-punk band led by Brendan B. Brown, best known for 'Teenage Dirtbag'.

name: Young Statues
description: Philadelphia indie rock band on Run For Cover Records, mixing emo-leaning guitar rock with alt-country.

name: shattered figures
description: Philadelphia band blending heavy alternative rock, slowcore, shoegaze and melodic post-punk, with a following in the Northeast underground.

name: 198X
description: Jersey Shore party band billed as an 80s tribute experience, a regular at Asbury Park Brewery.

name: 22° Halo
description: Philadelphia project making lo-fi, alternative-leaning indie pop.

name: Abby Lee Duo
description: Philadelphia singer Abby Lee's duo, playing blues, rock and retro soul.

name: Ajay
description: Philadelphia R&B and soul singer with a smooth falsetto, whose sets have included a cover of D'Angelo's 'Brown Sugar'.

name: Allegaeon
genre: technical death metal / melodic death metal
description: Colorado technical death metal band known for intricate, shifting songwriting; The Ossuary Lens brought back original vocalist Ezra Haynes.

name: Ari Carter
description: Philadelphia indie rock power trio with a fuzzy, art-rock and psychedelic edge they call 'bubblegrunge'.

name: B Street Band
description: Long-running Jersey Shore tribute to Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band.

name: Ballistic Berry
description: Rock band from the Jersey Shore bar circuit who also played the Doylestown Arts Festival.

name: Bandits on the Run
description: Trio from the Brooklyn-Queens border playing theatrical, story-driven indie folk with three-part harmonies.

name: Best Bear
description: Philadelphia slow-burn post-emo band with dreamy, sad indie guitar songs.

name: Big D And The Kids Table
description: Long-running Boston ska-punk band fronted by David McWane, known for relentless touring.

name: Big Easy Easton Brass
genre: New Orleans brass band / second line
description: Community New Orleans-style second line brass band from the Easton area, open to all ages, that plays parades and park concerts between Washington, NJ and Allentown.

name: Big Handsome
description: Band from Quakertown, PA, playing John & Peter's, Puck and PhilaMOCA.

name: Bikini Trill
description: Los Angeles surf-pop trio mixing island-style guitar, hip-hop beats and dreamy vocals; they tour nationally.

name: Blue Wave Ramblers
description: Bucks County acoustic four-piece with fiddle and mandolin, mixing bluegrass with rock and new wave into what they call 'bluewave'.

name: Bone Weapon
description: Philadelphia extreme metal band that shares bills with death metal and goregrind acts at Kung Fu Necktie and MilkBoy.

name: Boys Go To Jupiter
description: Brooklyn indie-pop band mixing soul, folk and punk with story-driven songs; debut album Meet Me After Practice came out in 2025.

name: Brass Against
description: Brass-and-vocals act that reworks heavy rock by Rage Against the Machine, Tool and Led Zeppelin with a full horn section.

name: Bright Paper Werewolves
description: Philadelphia Guided by Voices tribute band, named after one of their songs, playing regular nights at Kung Fu Necktie.

name: Brothers Saint
description: Philadelphia indie rock band playing Kung Fu Necktie and Ortlieb's.

name: Bruise Bath
description: Philadelphia six-piece 'gloom band' playing slow, heavy, reverb-soaked rock between post-metal and slowcore.

name: CC Coletti Band
description: New Jersey classic rock band fronted by CC Coletti, a former Meat Loaf backing singer, playing covers and originals.

name: Cadre Noir
description: Philadelphia band on bills at Johnny Brenda's, MilkBoy and Underground Arts.

name: Carbon Leaf
genre: indie folk rock / Americana / Celtic rock
description: Long-touring Virginia five-piece that ranges across folk rock, Americana, bluegrass and Celtic styles with a lot of instruments on stage.

name: Chemical X
description: North Jersey hardcore punk band from Little Ferry, NJ.

name: Chuck Prophet & His Cumbia Shoes
description: San Francisco songwriter Chuck Prophet's cumbia-driven project, mixing jangly roots rock with rockabilly and surf touches, made with the Salinas-area band ¿Qiensave?.

name: Cold Court
description: Philadelphia band mixing rock with experimental and electronic sounds, jokingly billed as the Skrillex of the Windmill scene.

name: Common Crime
description: Philadelphia alternative rock band that plays Kung Fu Necktie, MilkBoy and Flemington DIY.

name: Comprador
description: Philadelphia band playing PhilaMOCA and Kung Fu Necktie.

name: Consider the Source
description: New York instrumental trio playing a high-energy fusion of prog rock, jazz and Middle Eastern scales.

name: Cult Objects
description: Philadelphia band aiming for scrappy early-80s post-punk in the spirit of ESG and Bush Tetras.

name: Curb Alert
description: Local Delaware County group playing rock and roll, often at Punjab Live in Media.

name: Cut//slack
description: Philadelphia guitar-bass-drums trio playing scrappy alternative rock they jokingly call 'apple butter alt rock'.

name: Danny's Caribbean Jam
description: Lehigh Valley group playing upbeat island rhythms, a regular on ArtsQuest's free Williams Brew Stage and SteelStacks shows.

name: Deadlands
description: Long Island melodic metalcore band (singer Kasey Karlsen and guitarist-producer CJ Arey) on Spinefarm, putting a fresh spin on post-hardcore.

name: Dear Season
description: Philadelphia four-piece formed in 2023, blending emo, post-hardcore and math rock in the vein of The Wonder Years and Origami Angel.

name: Dig a Revel
description: New Jersey band playing rowdy, beer-soaked punk they call drunk-punk.

name: Dinner
description: Lambertville act playing quirky art-pop with prog touches.

name: Dirty Grass Players
description: Baltimore string-band quartet playing progressive bluegrass, with covers of Pink Floyd and the Grateful Dead mixed in.

name: Dread the Dead
description: Five-piece that plays Grateful Dead songs reworked as reggae, a regular at Punjab Live in Media.

name: Ecology: HomeStones
description: Long-running experimental noise project built around homemade robotics and electronics.

name: Edgardo Cintron & The Inca Band
description: Philadelphia Latin percussionist Edgardo Cintron's band, celebrating the music of Santana with Latin rock and jazz.

name: Ensemble Novo
description: Philadelphia-area instrumental five-piece playing samba, bossa nova and MPB with lots of improvisation, active for more than a decade.

name: FACE 2 FACE
genre: Billy Joel and Elton John tribute
description: Dual piano tribute in which Mike Santoro plays Billy Joel and Ronnie Smith plays Elton John, trading sets and finishing together.

name: Fantastic Cat
description: New York supergroup of four singer-songwriters (Anthony D'Amato, Brian Dunne, Don DiLego and Mike Montali) who trade lead vocals and instruments.

name: Fatboi Sharif
description: Abstract, horror-tinged underground rapper who records with producers like Roper Williams and appears on billy woods-adjacent labels.
